scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/mcp-server typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/shared typecheck
scripts.deploy: bun run format && bun run lint && bun run --cwd apps/web deploy
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:shell: docker compose exec db psql -U postgres -d ecma_spec
scripts.pdf:test: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/ingest-pdf && bun test tests/ingest-pdf/*.test.ts
scripts.test: export TEST_DATABASE_URL=${TEST_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/ecma_spec} && bun test tests/web/ && bun test tests/db/ && bun test tests/ingest-xsd/ && bun test tests/mcp-server/
